title: Add missing unit tests for ListView miscellaneous properties
body:
All 5 features (description, allowPrinting, rowHeight short/extra_tall, sort legacy string, filterableFields) were already implemented but lacked complete test coverage.

### Tests added

- **`ListView.test.tsx`** — 3 test cases for `filterableFields` whitelist (set, unset, empty array)
- **`SpecBridge.test.ts`** — `short` → `compact` and `extra_tall` → `spacious` density mapping assertions added to existing `maps rowHeight to density` test

### Implementation already in place (no code changes needed)

- `description` rendering gated by `appearance.showDescription` (ListView.tsx L1007-1012)
- `allowPrinting` print button calling `window.print()` (ListView.tsx L1326-1338)
- `rowHeight` enum mapping in both ListView.tsx (L452-457) and list-view.ts (L98-114)
- `sort` legacy `"field desc"` string parsing (ListView.tsx L294-312)
- `filterableFields` whitelist restriction on FilterBuilder (ListView.tsx L883-887)
